body.link:
<%
			String step = "";
			if("".equals(info.getSession("ID")) || info.getSession("ID") == null) {
				step = "NO_SESSION";
			} else {
				step = "MOVE_PAGE";
			}
		%>

userscript.function:
<% if("NO_SESSION".equals(step)){ %>
				Alert("세션이 없습니다.")
				return;
				
			<%} else if("MOVE_PAGE".equals(step)){ %>
				var f = document.createElement('form');
	            f.id = 'pf';
	            f.target = '_self';
	            f.style.display = 'none';
	            
	            var addHidden = function(form, name, value) {
	                var input = document.createElement('input');
	                input.type = 'hidden';
	                input.name = name;
	                input.value = value;
	                form.insertBefore(input, null);
	            }
	            
	            document.body.appendChild(f)
	            addHidden(f, "isHidden", "true");
	            
	            for(var i in Sepoa.request) {
	            	addHidden(f, i, Sepoa.request[i]);
	            }
	            
	            let key = "";
	            let target = "";
	            let resultObj = "";
	            
	            doServiceAjax('sepoa.svc.seal.SepoaReqSealService', 'CONNECTION', 'doSelectRequestList', {SMR_NUMBER : Sepoa.request.SMR_NUMBER, RETURN_TYPE: "JSON"}, function(so) {
            		let result = so.result[0];
            		resultObj = JSON.parse(result)[0];
            	}, false);
	            
	            if(Sepoa.request["DOC_TYPE"] == "ATTACH_DOC_TEMPLATE") {
	            	if(resultObj["SMR_STATUS"] == "C") {
            			key = Sepoa.request.SMR_NUMBER + "_" + Sepoa.request.SD_NUMBER;
            			target = "CONVERT_CERT_MERGE#CONVERT_CERT_ORG";
            		} else {
            			key = Sepoa.request.SMI_NUMBER;
            			target = "ATTACH_DOC_TEMPLATE";	            		
            		}
	            } else if(Sepoa.request["DOC_TYPE"] == "REQ_SEAL") {
           			key = Sepoa.request.SMR_NUMBER + "_" + Sepoa.request.SMD_NUMBER;
	            	if(resultObj["SMR_STATUS"] == "C") {
	            		if(resultObj["RE_FLAG"] == "R") {
	            			target = "REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC#REQ_SEAL";
	            		} else {
	            			target = "REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC#CONVERT_SEAL_MERGE#CONVERT_SEAL_ORG";
	            		}
            		} else {
            			target = "REQ_SEAL";	            		
            		}
	            } else if(Sepoa.request["DOC_TYPE"] == "EXT_SEAL_DOC") {
           			key = Sepoa.request.SMR_NUMBER + "_" + Sepoa.request.SMD_NUMBER;
            			target = "EXT_SEAL_DOC";	            		
	            }
	            
	            var docData = {
	            	KEY : key,
	            	TARGET : target
	            }
	            
	            addHidden(f, "DOC_DATA", JSON.stringify(docData));
	            addHidden(f, "WORK_TYPE", "T");
	            addHidden(f, "CONT_MODULE", "VIEW");
	            addHidden(f, "MODE", "COMPLETE");
	            addHidden(f, "BTN_CONFIG", ["IN", "OUT"]);
	            
	            f.action = (window.CONTEXT_NAME || '') + '/Contract/Module/SealModuleLayout.sux';
	            f.method = 'post';
	            f.submit();
	            return;
			<%} %>
